screen.title: Tesla US Official Homepage Reconstruction
screen.prompt:
Reconstruct the complete public US Tesla homepage with authentic styling, exact hierarchy, and full visual assets:

1. Visual Assets & Theme:
- Use genuine image assets: {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_7}} (hero trio on road / city skyline), {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_6}} (FSD POV cockpit visualization), {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_5}} (Model Y white road photo), and {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_4}} (Solar Roof & Powerwall home).
- Colors: Deep brand black #171a20, vibrant Tesla blue #3e6ae1 for primary actions, subtle neutral gray surfaces (#f4f4f4 / #f8f8f8), crisp white #ffffff, subtle light gray borders (#e2e2e2).
- Font family: Universal Sans / Inter, clean kerning, precise type scale.
- Completely eliminate any blank/gray placeholder boxes or missing icons.

2. Navigation Header (56px high, sticky/fixed, z-50):
- Left: Tesla SVG wordmark with wide tracking.
- Center: Vehicles, Energy, Charging, Semi, Discover, Shop with clean hover pill indicators.
- Right: Support icon (help circle / question mark), Region/Globe icon, and Account/Profile icon.

3. 3-Slide Hero Section (516px tall at y56, background with genuine image {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_7}}):
- Active Slide 1: Model Y. H1: 'Model Y' (48px font-medium). Subtitle/Offer: '1.99% APR Available' (20px font-normal). Dual CTA buttons: 'Order Now' (#3e6ae1 blue, text-white, px-6 py-2 rounded-md font-medium) and 'Learn More' (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md text-[#171a20], px-6 py-2 rounded-md font-medium).
- Slide pagination dots (3 dots, first active white pill).
- Interactive controls / carousel tabs for Slide 2 ('Model 3' - '1.99% APR Available') and Slide 3 ('Model Y L Premium' - 'Three Rows, Six Seats').

4. Full Self-Driving (Supervised) Section:
- Clean white background.
- Left column: Label 'AUTONOMOUS TECHNOLOGY', 40px heading 'Full Self-Driving (Supervised)¹', body 'Makes every drive easier. Subscribe for $99/mo.', metrics: '7x' 'Fewer Collisions than U.S. average' and observed freeze count '15,388,105,963' 'Autonomous miles driven to date (Source observed reference)', CTAs: 'Schedule Demo' (dark/black button) and 'Learn More' (light secondary button).
- Right column: Authentic driving visualization with {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_6}} with active UI overlay badge '• FSD Supervised Active', Speed limit badge, and 'Neural Net v12.5 End-to-End Artificial Intelligence'.

5. Wide Horizontal Vehicle Carousel:
- Section header: 'Vehicles' with subtext 'Explore models, lease estimates, and features' plus left/right circular nav arrows.
- Horizontal scrollable carousel containing authentic cards (width ~960px active / peek next):
  * Card 1: Long Wheelbase Midsize SUV | Model Y L Premium | Starting at $61,990² | Image {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_5}} | 'Order Now' and 'Learn More'
  * Card 2: Sport Sedan | Model 3 | Starting at $38,990 | Image {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_7}} (cropped) | 'Order Now' and 'Learn More'
  * Card 3: Midsize SUV | Model Y | Starting at $44,990 | Image {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_5}} | 'Order Now' and 'Learn More'
  * Card 4: Utility Truck | Cybertruck | Starting at $79,990 | Sharp metallic cyber aesthetic | 'Order Now' and 'Learn More'
  * Card 5: Certified Pre-Owned | Pre-Owned | 'Fully inspected, refurbished and road ready with an extended one-year warranty.' | 'View Inventory'

6. Two Light-Gray Offer Cards:
- Card A: 'Current Offers' - 'Explore limited-time offers on Tesla vehicles.' with button 'View Offers'.
- Card B: 'Inventory' - 'Find new and Certified Pre-Owned Tesla vehicles available immediately.' with button 'Shop Available'.

7. Find Your Charge Section:
- Header: 'Find Your Charge' - 'View the network of Tesla Superchargers and Destination Chargers available near you.'
- Metrics: '34,287' 'Superchargers Worldwide' and '381' 'Destination Chargers' with note '(Source-observed dynamic figures)'.
- Actions: 'View Network' (black pill) and 'Learn More' (outline pill).
- Interactive interactive map visualization showing accurate US nationwide charging corridor heat/dot map with search bar 'Enter address, city, or zip code' and 'Search'.

8. Clean Energy Carousel (3 Cards):
- Card 1: Residential Clean Power | 'Solar Panels' | 'Power Your Home and Reduce Your Electricity Bill' | Image {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_4}} | 'Order Now' & 'Learn More'
- Card 2: Whole Home Backup | 'Powerwall' | 'Keep Your Lights On During Outages' | Image {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_4}} (detail focus) | 'Order Now' & 'Learn More'
- Card 3: Commercial & Utility | 'Megapack' | 'Massive Batteries for Massive Energy Support' | Utility scale energy battery photo | 'Contact Us' & 'Learn More'

9. Exact Legal Footnotes & Footer:
- Paragraph 1: '¹ Price reflects monthly subscription, subject to terms and conditions. Price and feature availability subject to change.'
- Paragraph 2: '² Price listed does not include Destination and Order Fees, taxes and other fees. Subject to change. The Model Y L Premium starting price including the Destination and Order fees but excluding taxes and other fees is $63,630.'
- Footer links centered: 'Tesla © 2026', 'Privacy & Legal', 'Vehicle Recalls', 'Contact', 'News', 'Get Updates', 'Locations', 'Learn'.

10. Floating Sticky Bottom Bar:
- Subtle pill bar centered at bottom with 'Ask a Question' (chat icon) and 'Schedule a Drive Today' (steering wheel/calendar icon). Fully functional responsive layout.

designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style
The aesthetic embodies Tesla's clean, direct, automotive-grade digital experience: stark, minimal chrome allowing high-resolution cinematic automotive photography to take center stage. There are no decorative gradients, ornamental shadows, or skeuomorphic flourishes. Visual impact is created through precise typography, crisp rectangular layouts, clean edge alignments, and immediate visual hierarchy.

The tone is authoritative, understated, functional, and technological. The experience leads with official cinematic vehicle assets, crisp action prompts, and clean typography reminiscent of Tesla Universal Sans.

## Layout & Spacing
- **Fixed Navigation**: Desktop navigation sits fixed at a strict 56px height on a clean white surface with minimal horizontal padding.
- **Hero Carousel**: Desktop carousel height occupies 516px directly under the 56px header; on mobile devices (390×844), it expands to an immersive, nearly 700px portrait crop with overlaid wordmark.
- **Sections Flow**:
  1. 3-slide carousel (Model Y / Model 3 / Model Y L Premium).
  2. Full Self-Driving split video and feature card.
  3. Sideways 5-card vehicle model gallery.
  4. Current Offers & Inventory light-gray dual cards.
  5. Find Your Charge full-width map with Supercharger network metrics.
  6. Sideways 3-card Energy module (Solar Panels / Powerwall / Megapack).
  7. Minimal legal footnote disclaimer and flat text footer.

## Elevation & Depth
Elevation is achieved almost entirely without drop shadows. The design relies on flat, layered plane transitions and stark contrast:
- Photographic surfaces contrast directly against pure `#ffffff` canvas sections.
- Secondary modules like Inventory and Current Offers use soft flat fills (`#f4f4f4`) with crisp zero-elevation borders.
- Floating controls (such as hero carousel navigation arrows and pagination indicator dots) use translucent or crisp white pills over photography.

## Components
- **Buttons**:
  - Primary CTA: Solid `#3e6ae1` background, white label, sharp 4px border radius, 40px height on desktop; stretches to 168px or full-width on mobile.
  - Secondary CTA: Solid `#ffffff` background with `#171a20` text, or subtle translucent gray overlay on imagery.
- **Hero Carousel**:
  - Left/right chevrons vertically centered at mid-height.
  - Centered pagination dots at the bottom edge indicating active slide.
- **Cards & Galleries**:
  - Horizontally scrolling, snapping carousels for the 5-model vehicle line and 3-card energy line.
  - Light-gray container cards with zero drop-shadow and 4px corners for inventory and current offers.
- **Footer**:
  - Sparse legal text, single-line typography, understated links with muted `#5c5e62` tone.

# Tesla US current homepage, 2026-09-28
Minimal white chrome and Tesla Universal Sans-like typography over official cinematic car photography. Blue #3e6ae1 primary action, white secondary. Current US section order: three-slide Model Y/Model 3/Model Y L Premium hero; Full Self-Driving split video; five-model gallery; Current Offers and Inventory cards; Find Your Charge map; solar/powerwall/megapack gallery; sparse legal footer. Desktop hero is 516px under 56px nav, mobile hero nearly 700px tall with overlay wordmark and Menu.
